verifier: bd2 (max2 round 2, adversarial card verifier: burdam, dunsom)
commitReviewed: 60c3f8a15 (cards round 3, after the bd1 verdict); HEAD b34fd9b15
method: Read every shipped card in art/out/fighters/{burdam,dunsom} at full size, at card size (480 px wide), at 128 and 64 px (LANCZOS, enlarged nearest-neighbour for viewing), plus 3-4x crops of every face and every hand. Painted portraits A/B against art/.cache/fighters/paint/<sid>_3d.png (mean abs RGB diff and by eye), and against the version shipped before 60c3f8a15. Re-ran card_qa.py burdam dunsom (12 cards, 6 gate misses: blank tripwire on all six splashes) and node tools/gen_store.ts --check (store.json current, dE gate 32/32 pass).
cardQa: blank tripwire fails on all 6 splashes: burdam 0.83, burdam_stillwater 0.78, burdam_almanac 0.70, dunsom 0.88, dunsom_highrim 0.92, dunsom_almanac 0.81. Portraits pass: burdam 0.61, burdam_stillwater 0.54, burdam_almanac 0.64, dunsom 0.40, dunsom_highrim 0.35, dunsom_almanac 0.64. No glow, streak or cracked hits anywhere.
scoreNote: Gauge only. A recent LoL splash is a painted, dynamic, face-forward figure with designed value and clean anatomy. Round 3 fixed the framing: the heads are about 3x larger and the faces now read at full and card size (lidded eyes with pupils, brows, nose). But every splash is still the raw 3D finish on a painted plate (clay figure, near one-hue light), and three of the Dunsom/Stillwater poses show broken skinning: hands stretch into long spikes or crumple into torn lumps. The painted portraits are near-copies of the render (diff 2.7-9.2 of 255): a regrade, not painted form. Dunsom drops half a point from bd1 because the new hero poses expose the hand tearing on all three of his splashes.

perCard.issues: Face fixed and now readable at full and card size: carved brows, lidded eyes with brown pupils, nose keel, no hollow, glow, crack or streak. Still fails card_qa's blank gate (0.83), and at 128 / 64 the head is a pale egg on a peach figure that sinks into the orange domes (one hue throughout). The viewer-left hand on the cleaver is hidden under the pauldron cloth; the open palm on the right shoulder is fine. Raw 3D, not painted. Gate miss: keep the live card.

perCard.shipped: painted v1 (changed in 60c3f8a15: cooler scarf than the r2 file, diff 10.5 vs the r2 file, 9.2 vs the 3D)
perCard.issues: Passes card_qa now (blank 0.61) and by eye: at 512, 128 and 64 two lidded eyes with dark pupils under heavy brows, nose and frown; no hollow, glow, crack or streak. At 4x a short dark notch under the viewer-left cheek plate is the carved notch from the render, not a crack. Same pose, silhouette, palette and parts as the 3D render; no invented part. Quality: barely painted.

At 3x the bowed, turned face has lidded eyes with pupils, but the bald dome is about half the head and at card / chip size the face is a pale egg sunk into the purple scarf (card_qa blank 0.70). The fist on the cleaver has fingers; the forearm plates carry black crack lines (stone styling, reads as cracked at 3x). Gate miss: keep the live card.

Passes card_qa (blank 0.64, just under the threshold) and by eye: lidded eyes with pupils under the brows at 512 and 128; at 64 two dark slits on a stern carved face, not a skull or a blank. On-model with the render (diff 3.5): same bowed pose, scarf, tallies, no invented part. Borderline at 64; a regrade more than a painting. Minor: a bright yellow speck at the bottom-left corner, also in the render.

The face is now clear of the arm and reads at full and card size (frown, lidded eyes with pupils, no chin tallies). But the fist holding the cleaver over the shoulder is broken mesh: at 2x it is a crumpled brown lump with torn shards and no fingers (melted-hand read), and the blue pommel tile floats off it. card_qa blank 0.78 also fails.

The bd1 blocker is fixed: no chin tallies, no stitched-mouth read; the face (brows, lidded eyes with pupils, frown) is clean at 512, 128 and 64 and passes card_qa (blank 0.54). It fails on the same broken fist as the splash: top-left, the cleaver hand is a torn brown lump with dark slashes and no fingers; at 4x the slashes form a grimace-like pattern and at card size it reads as a dark brown sack, not a hand. The paint copied it from the render (diff 6.1). Fix: repair the gauntlet skinning in the carry pose or crop the fist out, then repaint.

The mask now reads at full and card size (lidded eyes with pupils, nose; mouthless by design; the scarf covers the chin). But the hand on the staff has stretched-skinning spikes: three claw-like prongs hang under the staff and the thumb is a thin wire loop (the round-1 claw read returns through the mesh). card_qa blank 0.88 fails; the figure is one pink-peach value on an orange plate.

The bd1 fix landed: head-and-shoulders under the brim, face about 30 % of the width, card_qa blank 0.40. Lidded eyes with pupils and a carved nose read at 512 and 128; at 64 the eyes are faint but the face still reads as a carved mask under a hat, not a blank, mummy or mannequin (the face is uncovered; the cream scarf sits below the chin). On-model (diff 2.7, essentially the render). Quality: not painted in any visible way.

Blocker-class mesh artefact: both hands explode into long golden spikes. The staff hand trails blades down past the waist, and the other hand is a fan of stretched shards down the robe (broken skinning). Looks like claws or shredded flesh at card size. card_qa blank 0.81 also fails. The face itself (rose mask, eyes with pupils) reads.

The bd1 fix landed: the mask is mid-rose now, not a dark oval, and passes card_qa (blank 0.64, glow 0.000). At 512 and 128 both eyes show amber irises with pupils in white sclera under lids; at 64 they are two pale dashes on a rose face, eye-shaped, not light points. No mummy read: the face is uncovered and the white wrap is a scarf below the chin. On-model (diff 4.4), no invented part. Borderline at 64 (thin margin on blank).

The raised hand at the brim has broken skinning: it is a torn lump, and long brown shards stretch from it down past the scarf to the belt. The staff fist is blocky but fingered. card_qa blank 0.92 fails (the highest of the twelve). Dirty white blotches on the robe hem.

Reverses bd1's pass. The painted card adds a long brown rod from the raised fist down across the scarf to the chest, and turns the fist into a garbled lump. The 3D reference (art/.cache/fighters/paint/dunsom_highrim_portrait_3d.png) shows a clean fist and no rod. This is the splash's stretched-skin shards repainted as a stick: an invented prop and a mangled hand. The version shipped before 60c3f8a15 has it too. The face (golden mask, lidded eyes) is fine and passes card_qa (blank 0.35).

problems.what: In the new hero poses, Dunsom's hand skinning breaks. Almanac: both hands burst into long golden spikes. Highrim: the raised hand trails shards to the belt, and the painted portrait turned them into an invented rod. Base: claw-prongs under the staff hand. The same weights may break in-game in any animation that reaches these poses; this verifier did not check the match client.
problems.fix: Fix the hand and finger weights or the pose in the Dunsom rig (cards lane owns the head and mask; the rig may need the fighter lane), re-render, and repaint the Highrim portrait from a clean render. Check the gameplay animations for the same stretch before shipping the GLB.

problems.what: In the lobby-carry pose the cleaver fist is a torn, fingerless lump with dark slashes. It reads as a melted hand, and in the portrait as a grimacing brown sack.
problems.fix: Fix the gauntlet skinning in the carry pose, or crop or turn it out of the portrait, then repaint the portrait.

problems.what: Every splash ships as the raw 3D finish (no painted variant passed), and every one trips card_qa's blank gate (0.70-0.92). The reframe made the faces readable at full and card size, but at 128 / 64 the heads are still pale shapes on single-hue figures.
problems.fix: Paint again after the hand fixes. A cleared blank tripwire should come from more face value contrast (darker eye sockets on the lids, a value break between mask and plate), not from a lower threshold.

problems.what: The passing portraits are near-copies of the render (diff 2.7-9.2), so they add no painted form. Ruling 30's intent is not met in quality, even though every gate passes.
problems.fix: None needed to ship; a stronger paint pass later, for quality.

notes: 4 of 12 pass. Changes from bd1: dunsom_portrait and dunsom_almanac_portrait now pass (the tight crop works). burdam_stillwater_portrait's stitched-mouth blocker is fixed, but the card fails on the torn fist. dunsom_highrim_portrait goes from ok to fail (invented rod, mangled fist; bd1 missed it). The same caveat as bd1 applies: a passing portrait ships beside a live pre-round-1 splash that still shows the old hollow mask (Burdam) or cracked mask (Dunsom), so the lead should decide whether to ship the portraits alone or hold them until the splashes pass. Neither fighter's cards reach par (7.5). Icons were not judged.
